title: Static illustration poses need foot IK, not a perfect clip
summary: No clip fits illustration poses (rope climber, prone chest-up, all fours). Nearest clip + handTo + a two-bone footTo + world-axis spine turns worked for every reference pose.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: C.play('Idle_Loop', 0).apply(); footTo(C, 'R', V(.56, -2.16, -.42), V(.6, -1.2, -.3)); C.handTo('R', ropePoint, { weight: 1, curl: .85 });

doc.when: Any pose from a still image (climbers, crawlers, kneelers, people standing on steps).
doc.avoid: Searching the clip library for an exact match.

problem.symptom: Hours spent on clips that almost fit; legs in the wrong place.
problem.cause: Clip libraries hold motions, not illustration poses; the kit had hand IK only.
problem.detect: A pose needs a foot on a specific surface.
